failure_type_description: Tool is replaced or fails at a randomly selected tool wear time between 200-240 minutes
prevention_strategy: Schedule tool replacement before 200 minutes of wear

failure_type_description: Occurs when temperature differential < 8.6K AND rotational speed < 1380 rpm
prevention_strategy: Monitor temperature differential and maintain minimum speed

failure_type_description: Occurs when power (torque × angular velocity) is outside 3500W-9000W range
prevention_strategy: Keep power output within operational bounds

failure_type_description: Occurs when tool_wear × torque exceeds threshold (L:11000, M:12000, H:13000)
prevention_strategy: Balance tool wear state with torque demands
